item.title: Nigeria’s telecoms regulator prepares ₦12.4B fine for poor network quality
item.description: On today's edition of Techpoint Digest, we discuss NCC's ₦12.4B fine for telcos, Esohe Igbinoba's spending on tech events, and a new DStv feature that allows friends to share bills.

item.title: Moniepoint disbursed ₦1 trillion in loans to 70,000 businesses in 2025
item.description: Moniepoint says it disbursed over ₦1 trillion in loans to 70,000 businesses in 2025. Provision stores received the most credit.

item.title: Report: Moniepoint says it handled 80% of Nigeria’s in-person payments in 2025
item.description: Moniepoint says it processed 8 in 10 in-person payments in Nigeria, ₦412 trillion and more than 14 billion transactions in 2025.

item.title: Six in ten African creators earn less than $100 monthly
item.description: The 2026 African Creator Economy report shows that Africa’s creator economy is worth $3B and is projected to reach $17.8B by 2030, yet 6 in 10 creators earn under $100 a month.

item.title: This startup is building the digital infrastructure to preserve and monetise Africa’s fine art
item.description: Atsur is building the digital infrastructure that allows African artworks to be tracked, authenticated, and traded securely.

item.title: Hackers pulled ₦7.7B in airtime and data from a telco
item.description: On today’s edition of Techpoint Digest, we discuss a ₦7.7bn telco hack that landed six suspects in police custody, Atsur’s push for African art to outlive its first buyer, and Moniepoint’s ₦1tn bet on small businesses.

item.title: Inside Owllup’s community-driven approach to talent development in Africa
item.description: In Nigeria, trending is easy, but getting paid is hard. Owllup is changing that by blending mentorship with a skill-to-wallet fintech pipeline.
